1790{

1799bool PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::Command::write(const yarp::os::idl::WireWriter& writer) const
1800{
1801 if (!writeTag(writer)) {
1802 return false;
1803 }
1804 if (!writeArgs(writer)) {
1805 return false;
1806 }
1807 return true;
1808}
1809
1810bool PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::Command::writeTag(const yarp::os::idl::WireWriter& writer) const
1811{
1812 if (!writer.writeTag(s_tag, 1, s_tag_len)) {
1813 return false;
1814 }
1815 return true;
1816}

1818bool PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::Command::writeArgs(const yarp::os::idl::WireWriter& writer) const
1819{
1820 if (!writer.writeString(portname)) {
1821 return false;
1822 }
1823 if (!writer.writeString(carrier)) {
1824 return false;
1825 }
1826 return true;
1827}
1828
1829bool PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::Command::read(yarp::os::idl::WireReader& reader)
1830{
1831 if (!readTag(reader)) {
1832 return false;
1833 }
1834 if (!readArgs(reader)) {
1835 return false;
1836 }
1837 return true;
1838}
1839
1840bool PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::Command::readTag(yarp::os::idl::WireReader& reader)
1841{
1842 std::string tag = reader.readTag(s_tag_len);
1843 if (reader.isError()) {
1844 return false;
1845 }
1846 if (tag != s_tag) {
1847 reader.fail();
1848 return false;
1849 }
1850 return true;
1851}
1852
1853bool PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::Command::readArgs(yarp::os::idl::WireReader& reader)
1854{
1855 if (reader.noMore()) {
1856 reader.fail();
1857 return false;
1858 }
1859 if (!reader.readString(portname)) {
1860 reader.fail();
1861 return false;
1862 }
1863 if (!reader.readString(carrier)) {
1864 carrier = "";
1865 }
1866 if (!reader.noMore()) {
1867 reader.fail();
1868 return false;
1869 }
1870 return true;
1871}

1873bool PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::Reply::write(yarp::os::ConnectionWriter& connection) const
1874{

1879bool PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::Reply::read(yarp::os::ConnectionReader& connection)
1880{
1881 yarp::os::idl::WireReader reader(connection);

1884
1885bool PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::Reply::write(const yarp::os::idl::WireWriter& writer) const
1886{
1887 if (!writer.isNull()) {
1888 if (!writer.writeListHeader(s_reply_len)) {
1889 return false;
1890 }
1891 if (!writer.write(return_helper)) {
1892 return false;
1893 }
1894 }
1895 return true;
1896}
1897
1898bool PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::Reply::read(yarp::os::idl::WireReader& reader)
1899{
1900 if (!reader.readListReturn()) {
1901 return false;
1902 }
1903 if (reader.noMore()) {
1904 reader.fail();
1905 return false;
1906 }
1907 if (!reader.read(return_helper)) {
1908 reader.fail();
1909 return false;
1910 }
1911 return true;
1912}

5958// read from ConnectionReader
5959bool PortCoreMsgs::read(yarp::os::ConnectionReader& connection)
5960{
5961 constexpr size_t max_tag_len = 1;
5962 size_t tag_len = 1;
5963
5964 yarp::os::idl::WireReader reader(connection);
5965 reader.expectAccept();
5966 if (!reader.readListHeader()) {
5967 reader.fail();
5968 return false;
5969 }
5970
5971 std::string tag = reader.readTag(1);
5972 bool direct = (tag == "__direct__");
5973 if (direct) {
5974 tag = reader.readTag(1);
5975 }
5976 while (tag_len <= max_tag_len && !reader.isError()) {
5977 if(tag == "getRemoteProtocolVersion") {
5978 if (!reader.noMore()) {
5979 yError("Reader invalid protocol?! %s:%d - %s", __FILE__, __LINE__, __YFUNCTION__);
5980 reader.fail();
5981 return false;
5982 }
5983
5984 auto proto = getLocalProtocolVersion();
5985
5986 yarp::os::idl::WireWriter writer(reader);
5987 if (!writer.writeListHeader(1)) {
5988 yWarning("Writer invalid protocol?! %s:%d - %s", __FILE__, __LINE__, __YFUNCTION__);
5989 return false;}
5990 if (!writer.write(proto)) {
5991 yWarning("Writer invalid protocol?! %s:%d - %s", __FILE__, __LINE__, __YFUNCTION__);
5992 return false;
5993 }
5994 reader.accept();
5995 return true;
5996 }
5997 if (tag == PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper::s_tag) {
5998 PortCoreMsgs_addConnection_helper helper;
5999 if (!helper.cmd.readArgs(reader)) {
6000 return false;
6001 }
6002
6003 helper.call(this);
6004
6005 yarp::os::idl::WireWriter writer(reader);
6006 if (!helper.reply.write(writer)) {
6007 return false;
6008 }
6009 reader.accept();
6010 return true;
6011 }
6012 if (tag == PortCoreMsgs_delConnection_helper::s_tag) {
6013 PortCoreMsgs_delConnection_helper helper;
6014 if (!helper.cmd.readArgs(reader)) {
6015 return false;
6016 }
6017
6018 helper.call(this);
6019
6020 yarp::os::idl::WireWriter writer(reader);
6021 if (!helper.reply.write(writer)) {
6022 return false;
6023 }
6024 reader.accept();
6025 return true;
6026 }
